title: 函館記念の後に・三つ眼はなくとも

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Relying on her own strength, Matikanefukukitaru makes her mark on the Hakodate Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After commemorating her victory at Goryokaku Fort, she reveals that there's a certain race she hopes to run in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Instead of letting her fortune slips do the honors, Matikanefukukitaru chooses to aim for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She stokes her passion, determined to earn her spot on her own merits, unlike what happened with the Takarazuka Kinen.
